name: lesson-loop
description: Self-improving learning loop for Claude Code. After a complex session, auto-extracts the workflow into a reusable skill (Hermes Agent style) so future sessions don't re-reason from scratch.

scope.title: Skill storage scope
scope.description: Where auto-extracted skills are saved. One of: global | project | auto. global = ~/.claude/skills (loaded in every project). project = <cwd>/.claude/skills (only the originating project). auto = project if cwd looks like a project (.git or .claude present), else global.
